# Demo Cases

# CASE 01 — M47

M47 is a fictional contemporary barbershop. The hero uses high-contrast editorial photography, warm side light, deep blacks, realistic hair texture and professional tools. Avoid vintage barber clichés, direct-to-camera stock posing and white backgrounds.

The HTML headline occupies the left side. Keep the subject and strongest detail on the right.

# CASE 02 — TAVOLA 27

Tavola 27 is a fictional contemporary Italian restaurant with natural light and an editorial visual language.
